displayedInputs.question:
A cone has base radius 5 and height 12. Its lateral surface area is \(k\pi\). Find the value of \(k\).

[Figure 1](attached-image-1)

The lateral surface of a cone unfolds into a sector with radius 6 and central angle \(120^\circ\). Find the base radius of this cone.

[Figure 1](attached-image-2)

\(PA\) is tangent to circle \(O\) at \(A\). What is the measure of \(\angle OAP\)? (Unit: degrees)

[Figure 1](attached-image-3)

\(DE\parallel BC\), and \(D\) and \(E\) lie on \(AB\) and \(AC\), respectively. Which pair of similar triangles is shown in the diagram? (In \(\triangle ABC\), \(D\) lies on \(AB\) and \(E\) lies on \(AC\); corresponding vertices are listed in order.)

[Figure 1](attached-image-4)

The cross section of a dam is a trapezoid \(ABCD\), with \(AD\parallel BC\). The top of the dam has width \(AD=6\text{ m}\), and the dam has height 4 m. The upstream slope \(AB\) has a slope ratio of \(1:1.5\), and the downstream slope \(CD\) has a slope ratio of \(1:2\). Find the length of the base \(BC\). (Unit: m)

[Figure 1](attached-image-5)

What shapes are the three views of a cylinder? Choose the correct answer.

[Figure 1](attached-image-6)

choices.A: The front and left views are rectangles, and the top view is a circle.
choices.B: The front and top views are rectangles, and the left view is a circle.

displayedInputs.question: Which of the following solids has a front view, left view, and top view that are all squares?

A solid is built from identical small cubes. Its top view is a grid with 2 rows and 2 columns. The number in each cell indicates the number of small cubes at that position: the first row contains 2, 1 in order, and the second row contains 1, 3 in order. How many small cubes were used in total?
